sample_notice: Synthetic, hand-authored, excerpt-rich demonstration fixture; not an exporter output.

nodes.title: Product North Star
nodes.summary: The durable outcome the product should create: faster confident decisions with less context hunting.

nodes.title: Operating Principles
nodes.summary: Small set of constraints used to resolve product and operating tradeoffs.

nodes.title: Pricing Hypotheses
nodes.summary: Current beliefs about value metrics, packaging, and willingness to pay.

nodes.title: Customer Interview Synthesis
nodes.summary: Recurring jobs, anxieties, and language from twelve customer conversations.

nodes.title: Early Churn Signals
nodes.summary: Patterns that appear in the two weeks before a workspace becomes inactive.

nodes.title: Support Pattern Review
nodes.summary: Themes from support conversations, grouped by friction and user intent.

nodes.title: Onboarding Findings
nodes.summary: What helps a new workspace reach the first useful map in under ten minutes.

nodes.title: System Map
nodes.summary: The product architecture, information boundaries, and critical dependencies.

nodes.title: Search & Retrieval Model
nodes.summary: How lexical evidence, authored links, and candidates combine without collapsing trust levels.

nodes.title: Evidence Drawer
nodes.summary: Interaction design for explaining why a connection exists and where it came from.

nodes.title: Launch Checklist
nodes.summary: Release gates covering privacy, recovery, evidence quality, and the public demo.

nodes.title: Decision Log
nodes.summary: Dated decisions with rationale, alternatives considered, and supersession notes.

nodes.title: Experiment Ledger
nodes.summary: What was tested, what happened, and which assumptions changed.

nodes.title: Weekly Review
nodes.summary: A recurring scan for stale beliefs, unresolved links, and forgotten ideas.

nodes.title: Voice & Tone
nodes.summary: Language principles: precise, curious, evidence-backed, and never artificially certain.

nodes.title: Product Story
nodes.summary: The narrative from scattered notes to a living, inspectable map of institutional memory.

evidence.source_text: The North Star is constrained by the operating principles, especially evidence before confidence.
This outcome is grounded in the customer interview synthesis.
First-session anxiety is explored further in the onboarding findings.
Three repeated setup questions map directly to onboarding friction.
Support silence after repeated retrieval friction is an early churn signal.
The retrieval boundary is specified in Search & Retrieval Model.
Every result exposes its reasoning through the evidence drawer.
Architecture and information boundaries must be current before release.
Every durable decision cites the principle used to resolve the tradeoff.
Experiments that change a durable belief produce a decision-log entry.
Review open experiments and record the resulting evidence.
Launch language follows the Voice & Tone constraints.
The public story ships with the launch checklist.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: both notes repeatedly connect trust, explanation, and abandonment.

source_evidence.passage: Workspaces often go quiet after repeated retrieval friction leaves people unsure why a result appeared.

target_evidence.passage: The evidence drawer must make each connection inspectable before a person decides whether it is useful.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: pricing language overlaps with interview language about confidence and time saved.

source_evidence.passage: The strongest pricing signal is confidence gained and decision time returned, not the number of notes indexed.

target_evidence.passage: Interviewees described value as reaching a confident next decision without rebuilding context from scratch.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: both notes discuss silence, inactivity, and stale state.

source_evidence.passage: The weekly review should call out quiet projects and beliefs that have not received a fresh signal.

target_evidence.passage: A workspace becoming quiet is often preceded by stale searches and fewer evidence checks.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: the product story may be a public expression of the internal North Star.

source_evidence.passage: The North Star is a faster, more confident decision made with inspectable context.

target_evidence.passage: RecallWeave turns scattered memory into a living map people can inspect before they decide.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: weekly review could become the human calibration loop for discovery quality.

source_evidence.passage: Candidate quality improves when useful and misleading connections are reviewed as separate evidence.

target_evidence.passage: Weekly review records which surfaced connections were useful, surprising, or safely ignored.

evidence.explanation: Candidate only: onboarding success correlates with plain, low-jargon explanations.

source_evidence.passage: New users reached a first useful map sooner when explanations avoided graph terminology.

target_evidence.passage: Use plain language, name uncertainty directly, and make the next action easy to understand.
